fields.PRODUCT NAME: Lotus of Love – Radha Krishna Marble Miniature Painting
fields.DESCRIPTION: Immerse yourself in the divine romance of Radha and Krishna with this elegant Lotus of Love – Rajasthani Miniature Painting on Marble. This exquisite artwork showcases Lord Krishna offering a lotus flower to Radha, symbolizing purity, love, and spiritual connection. The detailed hand-painted floral background and soft expressions reflect the traditional miniature painting style of Rajasthan.
